name: deribit-mcp
description: Deribit Options & Futures (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker, get_balances, list_orders, place_

platform_mcp_deribit_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DERIBIT_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_deribit_client_id.description: Client ID of a Deribit API key (Account > API). Give it trade:read_write and NOT wallet:read_write or account:read_write. A test-environment key comes from https://test.deribit.com and works only against https://test.deribit.com/api/v2 (set adapter.base_url to it).

platform_mcp_deribit_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DERIBIT_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_deribit_client_secret.description: The key's Client Secret; sent as HTTP Basic credentials (Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret)) on each request over TLS.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Extended account summaries: account id, username, type (main/subaccount) and per-currency balances.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every unexpired instrument across currencies (options, futures, perpetuals, spot) in one response; `query` is not sent. Cached by Deribit for about a minute.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: `symbol` is a Deribit instrument name such as BTC-PERPETUAL or BTC-27DEC26-100000-C.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: All open orders across currencies; `symbol` and `status` are not sent (the method has no instrument filter).

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: PLACES A REAL ORDER WITH REAL FUNDS on the configured host; it is not a simulation. Test with the Deribit test environment https://test.deribit.com/api/v2 first (edit adapter.base_url to point there), and never place an order the user has not explicitly confirmed. `side` selects private/buy or private/sell. `quantity` is Deribit's `amount`: USD for perpetuals and inverse futures (multiples of the contract size, e.g. 10), the base coin for options and linear futures. Limit orders need `price` (good_til_cancelled); omit it for market orders.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Only the order id is needed.
